caseName: Barclays Bank PLC v. Franchise Tax Board
caseNameFull: Barclays Bank PLC v. Franchise Tax Board of California and Colgate-Palmolive Co. v. Franchise Tax Board of California

opinions.text: Ct. App. Cal., 3d App. Dist. Motions of Government of the United Kingdom and Committee on State Taxation et al. for leave to file supplemental briefs as amici curiae in No. 92-1384 denied. Certiorari granted, cases consolidated, and a total of one and one-half hours allotted for oral argument.
